findings.evidence: Basic.lean:87 `eval₂_inputPolynomial` and Map.lean `map_eval_inputPolynomial_map` are both in the `CommSemiring` section. `polynomialRealization_eq_of_map_eq` is proved there with injectivity alone. The only use of the `L` assumptions is `have : Infinite L` feeding the over-`L` instance of the private `polynomialRealization_eq_iff`.
findings.fix: Add `polynomialRealization_map_eq_of_eq` (`K` a commutative ring that is an infinite domain, `L` a commutative semiring, any `φ`, no injectivity) for the reverse direction. Restate the iff with `[CommSemiring L]` as `⟨polynomialRealization_eq_of_map_eq hφ, polynomialRealization_map_eq_of_eq φ P w v⟩`, dropping `[CommRing L] [IsDomain L]`.
findings.issue: `polynomialRealization_map_eq_iff` requires `[CommRing L] [IsDomain L]` and derives `Infinite L` so it can run `polynomialRealization_eq_iff` over `L`. That is unnecessary. The forward direction is already `polynomialRealization_eq_of_map_eq`, which only needs commutative semirings and an injective `φ`. The reverse direction only needs `K` to be an infinite domain: funext over `K` gives equal coefficients, `map_eval_inputPolynomial_map` (stated for semirings) maps them, and `eval₂_inputPolynomial` over `L` turns them into equal functions. That works for any `φ` into any commutative semiring.

findings.evidence: Its proof is just `polynomialRealization_map_eq_iff hφ P v w`.
findings.fix: After generalizing the iff, change the section to `[CommRing K] [IsDomain K] [Infinite K] [CommSemiring L]`.
findings.issue: `preimage_fiber_polynomialRealization_map` inherits the same unnecessary `[CommRing L] [IsDomain L]` from the `Fibres` section variables.

summary: The transport lemmas are at the natural level, but the fibre comparison assumes `[CommRing L] [IsDomain L]` (and uses `Infinite L`) when only `K` needs to be an infinite domain. The direction from `K` to `L` doesn't even need `φ` to be injective.
